issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

newUserInvitationEmailDomainWhitelist.description:
Email domains that are allowed when inviting new users. By default, invited user email addresses must match the
email domain of the inviter. This config allows additional email domains to be whitelisted. Domains in this list
should include the `@` symbol.

Example: ["@c3.ai", "@c3iot.com"]

sendWelcomeEmail.description:
Defines whether to send the welcome email.

If set to `"never"` (default configuration), the welcome email will not be sent.

If set to `"onInvite"`, the welcome email will only be sent when users are created via
Genai.UserManagement.UiHelpers's createUsers. This API is called from the UI when users are invited via the
Gen AI User Management page. {@link User}s created via other means will not receive an email. In order for emails
to be sent, {@link SendGrid} must also be configured. See {@link SendGridApi} for setting keys.

userAlertsEmailList.description:
Email addresses that will recieve the alerts when {@link Genai.Retriever.IndexAction#monitorLongRunningIndexAction} fails

Example: ["support@c3.ai"]

sendAlertsEmail.description:
Defines whether to send the alerts email.

If set to `false` (default configuration), the alerts email will not be sent.

If set to `true`, the alerts will be sent when the
{@link Genai.Retriever.IndexAction#monitorLongRunningIndexAction} fails,
via the {@link Genai.Alert#alertLongRunningIndexAction}
